answer.reason: The verses give one defining event, Ephron's sale of the field and cave of Machpelah to Abraham, which the summary does not state.

clauses.english: sold Abraham the field and cave of Machpelah for four hundred shekels of silver
clauses.quote: Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver

doubts: The namesake line already says he sold the cave, so the clause may largely repeat it, but the sale is the only deed told of him.
